gp.note: the library's GP (Library._fit_inputs settings); N-104's folds, from its job cache

gp_refit.note: the library's GP refitted on the same folds for its sigma (N-104's cached folds keep none); a reference, not a challenger

mlp_s1.note: N-107's mlp with the network's random_state 1 (inner folds seed 0)

mlp_s2.note: N-107's mlp with the network's random_state 2 (inner folds seed 0)

mlp_s3.note: N-107's mlp with the network's random_state 3 (inner folds seed 0)

mlp_s4.note: N-107's mlp with the network's random_state 4 (inner folds seed 0)

mlp_gp_s0.note: N-107's mlp (8-configuration grid, inner folds seed 0, lbfgs, target standardized) with random_state=seed as the mean; the library's GP (Matern 5/2 ARD + White, normalize_y, 4 restarts, random_state 0) on its training residual; every part of a composed column the hybrid; MLP seed 0
